description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader to make a significant impact on resident care and operational excellence. Join a team committed to providing exceptional services and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff.This pivotal role offers a competitive salary range of $115,000 - $145,000 per year, reflecting the importance of this leadership position. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in guiding the facility's success, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards, and upholding the highest quality of care. If you are a proven leader with a passion for long-term care, we encourage you to explore this exciting opportunity.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Minimum of 3+ years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or long-term care environment.
Demonstrated expertise in facility operations, financial management, and regulatory compliance.
Strong leadership abilities with a focus on quality care and team development.
salaryOrBonusInfo: $115,000 - $145,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

description: We are seeking an experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a dedicated team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Red Bay, AL. This pivotal leadership role involves supporting the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations, ensuring high standards of patient care, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff.The ideal candidate will be instrumental in maintaining regulatory compliance, implementing best practices, and contributing to the overall success of our nursing department. This is an excellent opportunity for a compassionate and skilled RN looking to advance their leadership career within a supportive healthcare setting.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Alabama.
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, with at least 1 year in a supervisory or leadership role.
Prior experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care environment.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations.
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
